caption: An eval is a dataset, a task and a grader; the score gates changes in CI, and every failure found in production becomes a new case in the dataset, so the loop tightens over time.
alt: A golden dataset of cases is run through the system under test. A grader scores each output: code-based checks first, then an LLM judge for properties that need judgement. The pass rate is compared with a threshold and with the stored baseline, and the CI gate passes or fails the change. In production, failures are detected through feedback and monitoring, classified, and added to the dataset.
